items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of commitments for the specified organization and time period. Returns detailed information about each commitment including utilization, savings, and status. Results can be filtered by provider, search term, and custom criteria, and sorted by various attributes.

items.docs:
Generates time-series chart data for commitment metrics over the specified time period. The data includes daily or monthly values for commitment spend, utilization, locked vs unlocked commitments, and realized savings. Results are aggregated by day or month depending on the date range selected.
